boundaryPolicy.reflection: Dynamic lookup and registry references require a declaration-specific review entry when textual scanning cannot observe the name.
boundaryPolicy.generated: Generated Go, TypeScript, schema, and documentation artifacts are included in the reference corpus; generated-only boundaries require a declaration-specific review entry.
boundaryPolicy.interface: In-repository interfaces and standard interface method names are suppressed conservatively; external interface satisfaction requires a declaration-specific review entry.
boundaryPolicy.public-api: Public package compatibility is not inferred from repository references; a retained public declaration requires a declaration-specific review entry and owner review.
